done_when: send_message returns the host's real delivery result or a clear not-confirmed note, and a rate-limited IPC request waits for the next pass instead of being archived, proven by host and runner tests

findings.body: The deferral fix omits the browser IPC lane. In apps/core/src/runtime/ipc-browser-requests.ts:129–131, an authorized request over quota still throws after being claimed, and line 228 archives it. The watcher still invokes that processor at apps/core/src/runtime/ipc.ts:460. Consequently, a rate-limited browser IPC request is discarded rather than waiting for another pass, leaving the Done-when requirement unmet. Apply the deferral before claiming or consuming the request and prove subsequent processing.
findings.title: Not done: rate-limited IPC requests still get archived

findings.body: The new runner test manually supplies a signed failure response, while the host tests manufacture requests and inspect responses independently. No test exercises send_message through the real runtime to the host and back, and no runner test covers successful confirmation or the not-confirmed timeout note. Changing the timeout branch back to 'Message sent.' would leave these tests green. apps/core/AGENTS.md:110 and docs/review-instructions.md:30–35 require owner end-to-end coverage through the real runtime and Postgres with a fake channel and runner. Add that coverage for delivery reporting and quota deferral; the successful close run does not supply the missing assertions.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end proof of delivery reporting and quota deferral

why: Agents are told a message was sent before it is delivered, and overloaded messages are thrown away
